This is the multicast destination address of the layer 2 Ethernet packet. P hys Mask Ptr Pointer to memory containing the mask value in network byte order. Action Add or remove the address from the Wireless Ethernet controllers filter. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: filter was successfully changed E_ NOT_ OK: filter could not be changed Description Update the physical source address to/ from the indexed context filter. If the Wireless Ethernet Controller is not capable to do the filtering, the software has to do this. Available via WEth.h
